description: Two locators that no longer resolve, distinguished. The first names schema v1 for a record the corpus now holds at v2 — Clara migrates records between versions in place, and a record rewritten into another version is not the same evidence, so returning it would be the different revision the protocol forbids expansion from silently substituting. The second names an id the store does not hold at all, which is what `memory forget` and the signal lifecycle both produce. Both are locator_expired (-32003), and the messages differ so an operator can tell a migration from a deletion. The third is not a locator this adapter can read at all, which is locator_unknown (-32002) and a different fact.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
